## Verdict from research

Staying on DistilBERT SST-2 is not defensible on the merits: it is 2-class
movie-review sentiment with a thresholded pseudo-neutral, and an equal-latency,
Apache-2.0, finance-native 3-class model exists. The only reason to stay is
change-avoidance.

Ranked candidates (full survey with citations in the research agent's report;
handoff dir ad8ecca61944cd9fc, journal + baton):

1. **mrm8488/distilroberta-finetuned-financial-news-sentiment-analysis** — the
   same-cost upgrade. 82M params (vs 66M), same latency class, Apache-2.0, native
   3-class (0=negative, 1=neutral, 2=positive), ~202k downloads/month, drop-in for
   the existing transformers pipeline + S3 cold-start pattern. Caveat: its 0.9823
   accuracy is an in-split Financial PhraseBank number, strong in-domain evidence
   only.
2. **ProsusAI/finbert** — battle-tested default. ~110M, 3-class, 86-97% PhraseBank
   by annotator agreement (published paper), 5.5M downloads/month. ~2x latency
   (still trivial at 2048MB), frozen since 2023, license formalized only on the
   GitHub repo (Apache-2.0), HF weights untagged.
3. **tabularisai/ModernFinBERT** — only if cross-domain robustness matters. The one
   candidate with honest held-out benchmarks (avg 0.75 acc / 0.91 ROC-AUC across
   FiQA/Twitter/news). Young, low adoption, needs transformers >= 4.48, CPU latency
   unmeasured.

Rejected: yiyanghkust/finbert-tone (no license anywhere — production blocker);
deberta-v3 fine-tune (slowest per token, sentencepiece build dep, in-split evals);
general-domain successors (no consensus successor to SST-2 exists; finance-tuned
3-class dominates for headlines — searched 2026-08-05).

## Implementation notes for pickup

- Read `config.id2label` at load, never hardcode label indices: candidate label
  orders are mutually reversed (ProsusAI 0=positive; distilroberta 0=negative).
- Native neutral deletes the NEUTRAL_THRESHOLD=0.6 hack in
  src/lambdas/analysis/sentiment.py; signed mapping keys off the label either way.
- New S3 artifact + DEFAULT_MODEL_S3_KEY bump (sentiment.py:59); model_version on
  stored inferences already exists. MODELING.md documents no re-scoring path, so
  old and new model scores mix in history unless addressed; decide whether the
  30-day backfill machinery from signed-fanout is reusable for a re-score.
- Memory fine: largest candidate ~600MB f32 inside the 2048MB Lambda.
